metadata.description: Generate playable 3D roguelike levels: streets, buildings, houses, NPCs, and a map that unlocks

plugins.name: level-forge
plugins.description: Build and check 3D levels for duplexity-3d: a street with front doors, buildings with floors and stairwells, houses, NPCs who live in them, and a roguelike map whose exit gate opens once every instance is cleared. Deterministic generators, one command line, geometry proved on every build.
